title: Cluster Bar (App Switcher)
purpose: Tab bar showing cluster groups and the active cluster's open applications and terminals
states: multiple-clusters - several collapsed and one expanded
collapsed-cluster - cluster shown as chip with member count
expanded-cluster - cluster expanded showing all members
acceptance: shall display cluster chips as collapsible groups
shall show member count on collapsed cluster chips
shall expand active cluster showing all app tabs
shall collapse previous cluster when switching
shall show health warning badge on unhealthy clusters
shall allow closing clusters with × button
shall allow adding new cluster with + button
shall highlight active tab in open cluster
